They are excellent professionals and very kind. Everything is very clean, they have specialized veterinarians, and the service is very professional and friendly. There's usually no waiting time.
I've taken my four cats there and have always received professional and understanding treatment.

We took Dana to Clínica Veterinaria del Pilar and we couldn't be happier with the care she received. Erun and Dani are exceptional veterinarians—attentive, friendly, and highly professional.

From the very first moment, they treated Dana with so much love and patience, making the visit a truly positive experience. It's clear they love their work and genuinely care about the well-being of the animals.

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic for the professionalism of the entire team and the outstanding service they provide to dogs and their families. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Dana!
amazing !! aron was very nice and patient and clara was just so amazing! so gentle with my cats and took a lot of time to treat them. best vet i have ever been to
Highly recommended, they have a service to process CEXGAN applications
A very good clinic with amazing professionals and facilities; they have greatly helped my pet's well-being and quality of life.
Excellent service. Accurate diagnosis on the first visit and effective treatment. Staff are kind to both animals and their owners.

Fantastic! I'm delighted with El Pilar. The service is unbeatable, both for me and my dog. We always leave with a smile, and the whole team is very professional, attentive, and empathetic. I've always brought my pets here, and they're wonderful from beginning to end. Plus, they always get it right! Highly recommended!

From the very first moment, the treatment has always been impeccable, personal, and incredibly humane. They were a tremendous help with Shiro's diagnosis, and during such a difficult time as his passing, they supported me with a sensitivity and respect I will never forget.
With my other cat, thanks to Erun's quick and accurate diagnosis, we were able to treat him in time and save him. They are always there for any questions, available and attentive, which provides enormous peace of mind when it comes to our pets.

Erun is an incredible veterinarian, with vast knowledge and absolute dedication. Laura is a delight, always helping and making everything easier, and the rest of the team is simply fantastic. You can truly see that they are great animal lovers and that their work goes far beyond the professional.

I couldn't be more grateful. For me, they are undoubtedly the best.

We are so happy that we found this vet. All of the staff were very friendly and helpful. It was super easy to get an appointment quickly for a routine checkup and to get a pet passport for out little princess, Milly. Dr. Daniel was great. He was very gentle with  Milly and took the time to explain everything to us. Dr. Daniel and some of the staff speak English which was really helpful as well. Our experience was excellent and I highly recommend them.

I want to thank the team for the professionalism and care they show our pets: Dolça, Turia, and Puma. And also for their kindness to us, their owners, Ricardo and Manuela. Thirty years of knowing each other!

A friend recommended this clinic to me, and I'm really happy with them. It's a completely trustworthy clinic, and the way they treat pets is exceptional. Both the receptionist and the veterinarian are simply outstanding. I took my kitten there because he was getting sicker and sicker. They diagnosed the problem perfectly. They're the ones who saved my kitten, and now he's doing great. Thank you so much, ladies, keep up the good work, and never change!

Thank you for your response, but I must clarify something important.
I have reviewed Royal Decree 666/2023, and nowhere does it specifically prohibit dispensing medication simply because the prescription came from another clinic.
What the decree prohibits is veterinary clinics dispensing medication to the general public, regardless of who issued the prescription.
Therefore, attributing the refusal to "a prescription from another clinic" is an incorrect interpretation of the legal text.
The reality is that clinics cannot dispense medication at all, neither with their own prescriptions nor those of others. That is the rule.
Blaming "an external prescription" can be misleading and does not accurately reflect what Royal Decree 666/2023 establishes.
I would appreciate it if the legal arguments could be communicated precisely, as clients also have the right to truthful and clear information.
Incredible customer service. They were very kind and reassuring when my dog ​​got sick. I now have a trusted vet in Valencia.

The El Pilar veterinary clinic is truly outstanding! The staff is incredibly helpful, friendly, and shows genuine care for the animals. Every time I needed assistance, I was able to get an appointment right away, which makes a huge difference when your pet needs attention. Their services are reliable and professional — I always feel that my pet is in good hands. I highly recommend this clinic!

Excellent veterinary clinic... I took my dog ​​there because she wasn't feeling well, and Clara took care of her. She has the patience of a saint, she treated us very well, and my dog ​​was delighted. Thank you so much, you are very professional.

We are so happy we found such a wonderful Vet! Our spanish is functional yet the Vet spoke fluent English and put us at ease (dog included:) Their staff and office are very professional and welcoming to us and our dog. We live nearby and sometimes just pop in to say hello and they always have a smile and a treat for our dog. Highly recommend!
The veterinarians are super loving with the animals
I have seen the interest and professionalism shown to both the clients and their pets.
